identity.title: Prove canonical fixture compatibility matrix across known producers

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Build a small explicit compatibility matrix over the current canonical evidence fixtures already justified by production or conformance work: production-derived EverRun, existing generic second producer, and existing canonical valid fixtures. Prove each traverses the same audit/import/rebuild/report boundary while preserving its own facts and unknowns.
human_pressure.why_now: No Framework Left Behind requires evidence that the canonical boundary remains producer-neutral as real EverRun support hardens.
do_not_misread: A compatibility matrix is not a promise for every framework implementation.
Do not add fake framework fixtures just to increase the count.

machine_core.goal: Create a bounded compatibility regression matrix for all currently evidence-backed canonical producer fixtures.
red_lines: Do not claim unsupported frameworks are proven.
Do not modify fixtures to force identical outcomes.
invariants: All producers pass the same package validator and canonical pipeline.
Different evidence may yield different governance outcomes without violating neutrality.
Matrix entries cite concrete fixture paths and expected canonical facts.

observable_effect.assertion: Known producers remain compatible through one shared validation/projection/report path with no identity branching.

proofs.assertion: Matrix-driven focused tests plus full suite pass.

failure_semantics: A producer-specific failure is recorded as a conformance regression, not patched with identity-specific logic.
Unsupported producer claims remain explicitly unproven.

steps.title: Inventory evidence-backed fixtures
details: Include only fixtures already justified by production dogfood or existing conformance tests.

steps.title: Define expected canonical facts
details: For each fixture record audit acceptance and a minimal set of evidence-backed projection/report facts.

steps.title: Run shared-path matrix
details: Parameterize the same pipeline rather than branching by producer.

steps.title: Document proven boundary
details: State exactly what producers are proven and what remains unproven.

acceptance: Every matrix entry uses the same validation/import/rebuild/report path.
No producer identity branch is introduced.
Expected facts come from fixture evidence.
Unsupported frameworks are not claimed as proven.

must_check: All entries execute one shared code path.
Expected outcomes are not forced equal.
reject_if: Synthetic framework names are added without real fixtures/evidence.
Core code branches on producer identity.
Fixtures are edited to manufacture parity.
